data.title: 诱宵美九 · 极光舞台上的破军歌姬绝响
data.description: 万众瞩目的万人穹顶舞台，美九展开光辉璀璨的神威灵装·九番，巨大灵光键盘在虚空环绕，歌姬高亢咏唱震撼全场。
data.location: 未来科幻穹顶演唱会主舞台
data.action: 单手握着华丽立麦仰头高歌，另一手在空中虚按光芒键盘，紫色长卷发如浪涛翻飞
data.lighting: 舞台耀眼的极光紫与黄金聚光灯交织，虚空琴键绽放金色音符粒子
data.camera: 低角度动态仰拍，展现宏大舞台震撼力与歌姬王者气场
data.promptProse: Miku Izayoi delivers a spellbinding vocal climax at the center of a colossal dome arena, her voice echoing beneath thousands of laser beams. She wears her divine astral spirit dress adorned with glowing lavender fabrics, delicate golden armor, and trailing translucent frills. Floating golden keyboard keys encircle her in mid-air as she belts into an ornate microphone, her voluminous purple curls billowing wildly in the sonic storm.
data.animaCaption: Surrounded by floating holographic light keys, Miku sings passionately into the microphone beneath radiant arena spotlights.
